title: 第十七章 建立未来团队第十八章 银海湾救人
content_zh:
回到邹家成的餐厅，一看全部爆满，我对他说：“你看看，这么忙你还上山陪我们，你也真是的。
这样吧！
你忙你的，我们去别处转转？”
邹家成连忙拦住我：“别！
我还有地儿呢！
只要你们不嫌弃。”
我说：“还有地儿？怎么不给外面等叫号的呢？”
他说：“他们不会去的。”
我奇了怪了：“为啥？”
他嘿嘿一笑：“厨房。”
看着我眉头上扬的表情，一把将我拽住，“走啊！”
我装作被打劫的样子往后看着伊万：“Help！”
伊万耸肩微笑的让我很是绝望，便又转向紫萱：“紫萱，救命啊！”
紫萱也笑着并且鄙夷的摇摇头：“你向我求救？是吗？”
我赶忙说：“当然啦！
Helpme！”
紫萱继续摇摇头：“可是你第一次求救不是向我求救啊！
我是你选填的第二志愿哪！
一般第二志愿都不那个啥的。”
餐厅里的人都在看我们的动作，三斤姐说：“赶紧赶紧，我都不好意思了。”

我就这样给拖进了厨房，后面跟着这几个一心想吃海鲜的家伙。
穿过热火朝天的厨房，推开后门，原来是个院子，矮仔成再推开面前爬满百香果的竹篱笆，转了个弯，一片绿色映入眼帘，平地上水泥著称的葡萄架上，两棵从地上长出的葡萄爬得正欢，一串串披着白霜的小葡萄轻轻的摇着，像幼儿园里正在睡觉的小娃儿呢！
这块平地给矮仔成改成了花果园，矮墙外是一个鱼塘，不过塘水就有点不敢恭维了，和村里路边的小沟渠的水差不离。
矮墙边上种着好几棵火龙果，有的开花有的已经结了果，红艳艳的。
在葡萄架下，有一张圆桌，几张凳子。
有了植物的隔离，厨房灶头的轰轰声也被隔离了很多，没啥噪音。
“哎，我说矮仔成，你这个地方我怎么不知道？挺好的呀！”
我拍拍他的肩膀。
“哦，没我的事的时候，我都在这里待着，对着植物好，空气好，它们心眼从来都不坏，只会源源不绝的给我们呼吸的源动力。
哎，要来点音乐吗？我这儿有！”
没等我们反应过来，他就从圆桌下拉出一个小半人高的音箱，再从圆桌的抽屉里摸了个U盘出来，插到音箱的屁股后面，“啪”
的打开开关，“我喜欢听萨克斯，不要介意。”
音箱传出的是肯尼G的萨克斯，以前很流行。
“要是我介意呢？”
紫萱笑着问邹家成。
“哦哦哦，那行，放其他的。
不过我这里没有下载其他的。”
content_en:
When I returned to Zou Jiacheng's restaurant, I saw that it was full. I said to him: "Look, you are so busy and you still go up to the mountain to accompany us. You are serious."
So be it!
You're busy with your business, why don't we go somewhere else? "
Zou Jiacheng stopped me quickly: "No!
I still have room!
As long as you don't dislike it. "
I said, "Is there still room? Why don't we let people wait outside to be called?"
"They're not going," he said.
I was surprised: "Why?"
He chuckled: "Kitchen."
Seeing my raised brows, he grabbed me and said, "Let's go!"
I pretended to be robbed and looked back at Ivan: "Help!"
Ivan shrugged and smiled, which made me despair, and then turned to Zixuan: "Zixuan, help!"
Zixuan also smiled and shook her head disdainfully: "You asked me for help? Really?"
I quickly said: "Of course!
Helpme! "
Zixuan continued to shake her head: "But the first time you asked for help was not from me!
I am your second choice!
Usually the second choice is nothing like that. "
Everyone in the restaurant was watching our actions. Sister Sanjin said, "Hurry up, I'm even embarrassed."
I was dragged into the kitchen, followed by these guys who wanted to eat seafood.
Passing through the bustling kitchen and pushing open the back door, it turned out to be a yard. Xiao Zaicheng then pushed open the bamboo fence covered with passion fruit in front of him and turned a corner. A green patch of green came into view. On the famous cement grape trellis on the flat ground, two grapes growing from the ground were happily climbing. A bunch of small grapes covered with white frost were swaying gently, like a sleeping baby in a kindergarten!
This piece of flat land was transformed into a flower orchard by Aizi Cheng. Outside the low wall was a fish pond, but the water in the pond was a bit unflattering. It was almost the same as the water in the small ditch on the roadside of the village.
There are several dragon fruit trees planted beside the low wall, some are in bloom and some have already produced fruits, which are bright red.
Under the grape trellis, there is a round table and several stools.
With the isolation of plants, the roaring sound of the kitchen stove is also isolated a lot, and there is no noise.
"Hey, let me tell you, Xiao Zaicheng, why don't I know about your place? It's pretty good!"
I patted his shoulder.
"Oh, when I don't have anything else to do, I stay here all the time. I am good to the plants and the air. They are never evil-minded and will only give us a steady stream of energy to breathe.
Hey, want some music? I have it here! "
Before we could react, he pulled out a speaker that was smaller than half a person's height from under the round table, took out a USB flash drive from the drawer of the round table, inserted it into the back of the speaker, and said, "Pop!"
to turn on the switch, "I like to listen to the saxophone, don't mind."
What comes out of the speakers is Kenny G’s saxophone, which was very popular in the past.
"What if I mind?"
Zixuan asked Zou Jiacheng with a smile.
“Oh oh oh, okay, let’s put the others.
But I haven’t downloaded anything else here. "
